Three things in the data needed handling before the Q2 numbers matched:
- **Time zone:** order times are stored in UTC. I converted them to Korean time (+9 hours) before splitting by quarter and month. Without this, the Q2 results came out wrong.
- **Segment and category names:** some have different capitalisation or stray spaces (e.g. `Enterprise `, `SMB`, ` consumer`). I trimmed spaces and lowercased them so each one counts as a single group.
- **Duplicate customers:** some customers appear under more than one ID with the same email. I counted customers by email, which brought Q2's b and f to 241 and 202.
